primary_endpoint: ≥1-stage fibrosis improvement without worsening of NASH at Week 48; event-free survival at Week 240.
efficacy_outcome: At Week 48, fibrosis improvement occurred in 9.6% (SEL 18 mg), 12.1% (SEL 6 mg), and 13.2% (placebo); p=0.4941 and p=0.9321, respectively. No Week 240 event-free survival result was reported.
safety_signal: Serious AEs affected 47/322 participants on SEL 18 mg, 36/321 on SEL 6 mg, and 17/159 on placebo; no deaths were reported in these groups.
